segments.ja454:1.1: Uṭṭhehi kaṇha kiṃ sesi, ko attho supanena te;
segments.ja454:1.3: Yopi tuyhaṃ [tāyaṃ (pī.)] sako bhātā, hadayaṃ cakkhu ca [cakkhuṃva (pī.)] dakkhiṇaṃ;
segments.ja454:1.5: Tassa vātā balīyanti, ghaṭo jappati [sasaṃ jappati (?)] kesava.
segments.ja454:2.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, rohiṇeyyassa kesavo;
segments.ja454:3.1: Kiṃ nu ummattarūpova, kevalaṃ dvārakaṃ imaṃ;
segments.ja454:3.3: Saso sasoti lapasi, ko nu te sasamāhari.
segments.ja454:6.1: Na cāhamete [na cāhametaṃ (sī.), na vāhamete (syā.), na vāhametaṃ (pī.)] icchāmi, ye sasā pathavissitā [paṭhaviṃsitā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja454:6.3: Candato sasamicchāmi, taṃ me ohara kesava.
segments.ja454:7.1: So nūna madhuraṃ ñāti, jīvitaṃ vijahissasi;
segments.ja454:8.3: Kasmā pure mataṃ puttaṃ, ajjāpi manusocasi.
segments.ja454:9.1: Yaṃ na labbhā manussena, amanussena vā puna [pana (pe. va.215)];
segments.ja454:9.3: Jāto me mā marī putto, kuto labbhā alabbhiyaṃ.
segments.ja454:10.1: Na mantā mūlabhesajjā, osadhehi dhanena vā;
segments.ja454:12.1: Ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ, ghatasittaṃva pāvakaṃ;
segments.ja454:12.3: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
segments.ja454:13.1: Abbahī vata me sallaṃ, yamāsi hadayassitaṃ;
segments.ja454:14.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna māṇava [bhātika (pe. va.224)].
segments.ja454:15.1: Evaṃ karonti sappaññā, ye honti anukampakā;
segments.ja454:19.1: Daḷha kaṇha dhanañjaya saṅkhavaro, raja sattaha kassa ca [sattāhasasākha (syā.)] takkalinā;
segments.ja454:19.3: Dhammaṃ kukkuṭa kuṇḍali bhojanadā, cakkavāka subhūrisa sotthi ghaṭoti.

lines: Hadayaṃ cakkhu ca dakkhiṇanti hadayena ceva dakkhiṇacakkhunā ca samānoti attho.
Tassa vātā balīyantīti tassa hadayaṃ apasmāravātā avattharantīti attho.
Kesavāti so kira kesasobhanatāya “kesavā”ti paññāyittha, tena taṃ nāmenālapati.
Evaṃ amaccena vutte tassa ummattakabhāvaṃ ñatvā satthā abhisambuddho hutvā dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
Rājā uṭṭhāya sīghaṃ pāsādā otaritvā ghaṭapaṇḍitassa santikaṃ gantvā ubhosu hatthesu daḷhaṃ gahetvā tena saddhiṃ sallapanto tatiyaṃ gāthamāha –
Saso sasoti lapasi, ko nu te sasamāharī”ti.
Tattha kevalaṃ dvārakaṃ imanti kasmā ummattako viya hutvā sakalaṃ imaṃ dvāravatinagaraṃ vicaranto “saso saso”ti lapasi.
Ko tava sasaṃ hari, kena te saso gahitoti pucchati.
So raññā evaṃ vuttepi punappunaṃ tadeva vacanaṃ vadati.

Tatrāyaṃ saṅkhepattho – tesu suvaṇṇamayādīsu yaṃ icchasi, taṃ vada, ahaṃ te kāretvā dassāmi, athāpi te na rocesi, aññepi araññe vanagocarā sasakā atthi, tepi te ānayissāmi, vada bhadramukha, kīdisaṃ sasamicchasīti.
Rañño kathaṃ sutvā ghaṭapaṇḍito chaṭṭhaṃ gāthamāha –
Candato sasamicchāmi, taṃ me ohara kesavā”ti.
Rājā tassa kathaṃ sutvā “nissaṃsayaṃ me bhātā ummattakova jāto”ti domanassappatto sattamaṃ gāthamāha –
“tāta, mayhaṃ piyañāti so tvaṃ nūna atimadhuraṃ attano jīvitaṃ vijahissasi, yo apatthetabbaṃ patthayasī”ti.
Ghaṭapaṇḍito rañño vacanaṃ sutvā niccalo ṭhatvā “bhātika, tvaṃ candato sasakaṃ patthentassa taṃ alabhitvā jīvitakkhayabhāvaṃ jānanto kiṃ kāraṇā mataputtaṃ anusocasī”ti vatvā aṭṭhamaṃ gāthamāha –
Kasmā pure mataṃ puttaṃ, ajjāpi manusocasī”ti.
Tattha evanti idaṃ alabbhaneyyaṭṭhānaṃ nāma na patthetabbanti yadi evaṃ jānāsi.
Yadaññamanusāsasīti evaṃ jānantova yadi aññaṃ anusāsasīti attho.
Pureti atha kasmā ito catumāsamatthake mataputtaṃ ajjāpi anusocasīti vadati.
Evaṃ so antaravīthiyaṃ ṭhitakova “bhātika, ahaṃ tāva paññāyamānaṃ patthemi, tvaṃ pana apaññāyamānassa socasī”ti vatvā tassa dhammaṃ desento puna dve gāthā abhāsi –
“Yaṃ na labbhā manussena, amanussena vā puna;
Jāto me mā marī putto, kuto labbhā alabbhiyaṃ.
Tattha yanti bhātika yaṃ evaṃ jāto me putto mā marīti manussena vā devena vā puna na labbhā na sakkā laddhuṃ, taṃ tvaṃ patthesi, tadetaṃ kuto labbhā kena kāraṇena sakkā laddhuṃ, na sakkāti dīpeti.
“yaṃ tvaṃ petamanusocasi, taṃ etehi mantapayogādīhi ānetuṃ na sakkā”ti.
